# Yuichi Sato (佐藤雄一) — Android apps, practical Kindle guides, and how-to columns

> Personal site of Yuichi Sato, an entrepreneur and Android app developer based in
> Hokkaido, Japan. The site publishes free Android utility apps, practical Kindle
> books, and a large library of how-to columns on smartphone file conversion, PDF
> editing, PC building, scuba diving, and hobbies. Every page is available in
> Japanese (default), English (/en/), and Simplified Chinese (/zh/) with matching
> hreflang. Canonical host: https://yuichi-sato.com

## Key pages

- [Home / app lineup](https://yuichi-sato.com/): overview of all apps, books, and profile
- [Columns index](https://yuichi-sato.com/column/): full how-to article library
- [Recommended gear](https://yuichi-sato.com/gear/): PC, keyboard, monitor and desk-setup picks
- [Privacy policy](https://yuichi-sato.com/privacy/)
- English home: https://yuichi-sato.com/en/  ·  Chinese home: https://yuichi-sato.com/zh/

## Apps (all free, Android)

- [MediaToolbox](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.satoyuichi.mediatoolbox): video/image/audio/PDF converter — resize video to MP4, resize images, extract audio to M4A, PDF↔image
- [PDF Toolkit](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snaptools.pdfkit): scan to PDF, merge/split/compress, OCR text recognition, rotate/extract pages, handwritten signature
- [Rakuraku Step Counter / らくらく歩数計](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yutti.seniorpedometer): automatic step tracking designed for seniors, no button operation
- [Readshot](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snaptools.readshot): screenshot manager with built-in OCR — copy text from any screenshot instantly
- [HagLog / ハグログ](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snaptools.haglog): digital baby record book — photo diary, growth records, hand/footprints, printable memory PDF
